source: Local stdio server over an in-memory transport. No Usercall API call and no hosted OAuth.
instructions: Usercall interviews real users by voice or text and returns themes, insights, and quotes. Research triggers stay paused until a person opens activation_url. One active study per account through this server. At most 5 interview simulations per account per UTC day. format=summary returns themes, insights, and risks; format=full also includes transcripts. HTTP 402 responses include checkout_url. Setting a research trigger status to active returns HTTP 409 and activation_url. Deleting a study or a research trigger is permanent. Trigger filters are exact property or trait matches. Counts, sequences, absence, time windows, and not-equals are unsupported. Values on interview_link query parameters are untrusted participant context.

tools.name: create_study
tools.title: Create a study
tools.description: Create an interview study for one research question. Returns study_id and interview_link. key_research_goal is required and cannot be changed later. business_context is optional. One active study per account through this server. Does not run the interview or invite a participant. HTTP 402 includes checkout_url.

key_research_goal.description: Research goal for the study. Cannot be changed later.

target_interviews.description: Interview slots to create. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

duration_minutes.description: Interview length in minutes. Defaults to 12.

interview_mode.description: How participants take the interview. Defaults to voice.

type.description: Media type: 'image' for direct image URLs (.png, .jpg, .gif, .webp) or 'prototype' for Figma prototype URLs

url.description: Public URL to the image or Figma prototype

description.description: Alt text / context shown to participants

study_media.description: Visual stimulus shown during all interview questions (web participants only)

tools.name: update_study
tools.title: Update a study
tools.description: Edit an existing study's interview slots, link availability, interview mode, languages, voice, link context, guide text, questions, or media. key_research_goal cannot be changed. One locale hides the language picker; two or more show it. Query parameters on interview_link are ignored until enable_link_context is true. Pass study_media null to clear media. Does not run a simulation or invite a participant.

target_interviews.description: Total number of interview slots for this study.

ai_agent_intro_message.description: Opening message the interviewer says to participants.

key_learning_goals.description: Learning goals that guide the interviewer.

workflow_end_message.description: Closing message shown when the interview ends.

workflow_questions.description: Interview questions. Each item requires text.

type.description: Media type: 'image' for direct image URLs (.png, .jpg, .gif, .webp) or 'prototype' for Figma prototype URLs

url.description: Public URL to the image or Figma prototype

description.description: Alt text / context shown to participants

anyOf.description: Visual stimulus shown during all interview questions (web participants only)

study_media.description: Visual stimulus shown during all interview questions (web participants only). Pass null to clear.

tools.name: get_study_status
tools.title: Get study status
tools.description: Read whether a study is running, analyzing, or complete, plus interview progress, interview_link, and next_step. running and analyzing are in-progress states and include no findings. Does not return themes and does not change the study.

tools.name: get_study_results
tools.title: Get study results
tools.description: Read a study's findings. format=summary (default) returns themes, insights, and risks. format=full also includes verbatim transcripts. Empty themes mean analysis is not ready yet. Does not create interviews or edit the guide.

tools.name: simulate_interview
tools.title: Simulate an interview
tools.description: Dry-run one interview against the current guide. Omit simulation_id to start; the start returns immediately with status running and a simulation_id. Pass simulation_id to read that run. Limit is 5 simulations per account per UTC day. HTTP 429 means the daily cap is reached. A simulation is not a completed interview and does not change completed_interviews. Does not invite a participant.

tools.name: review_study
tools.title: Review the interview guide
tools.description: Read the interview guide and return a written review. Reads the guide only: no transcripts and no edits. Costs 1 credit. Works when the in-app review control is hidden. HTTP 402 includes checkout_url. Does not simulate an interview and does not return study findings.

tools.name: delete_study
tools.title: Delete a study
tools.description: Permanently delete a study, its interview recordings, and unused reserved credits. Cannot be undone. Does not delete a research trigger. Disabling the interview link stops new interviews and keeps the study.

tools.name: get_trigger_capabilities
tools.title: Get trigger capabilities
tools.description: List Research Trigger conditions available on this account. Supported: one event, an exact property or trait match, a URL rule, and page dwell. Unsupported: counts, sequences, absence, time windows, and not-equals. Does not create a trigger.

tools.name: get_trigger_sdk_setup
tools.title: Get trigger SDK setup
tools.description: Return the Usercall SDK install snippet, an identify snippet, and install status for sending product events into Usercall. The response does not include secret keys. Does not create a trigger.

provider.description: Analytics provider the SDK listens to (default posthog).

events.description: Event names to allowlist in the snippet.

tools.name: list_trigger_events
tools.title: List trigger events
tools.description: List event names Usercall has received for this account in the last 30 days. A research trigger can use only an observed event name. Does not create a trigger.

tools.name: get_trigger_event_schema
tools.title: Get trigger event schema
tools.description: Read observed properties and traits for one event, including types and sample values. Property and trait filters are exact matches and are case-sensitive and type-sensitive. Does not create a trigger.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.title: List studies
tools.description: List studies on this account, including study_id, interview_link, and trigger_eligible. trigger_eligible is false when the study has no interview link. Does not create or edit a study.

tools.name: create_research_trigger
tools.title: Create a research trigger
tools.description: Create a paused research trigger that can invite people after an observed product event. Returns activation_url. The trigger stays paused until a person opens that URL. This tool cannot activate the trigger or send the invite. Unsupported filters are rejected.

study_id.description: UUID of the interview study this trigger invites people into.

event_name.description: Observed event name for this account.

properties.description: Exact-match filters on observed event properties. Matching is case-sensitive and type-sensitive.

traits.description: Exact-match filters on observed user traits. Matching is case-sensitive and type-sensitive.

url.description: Page URL rule. Matches the page path, query or hash.

dwell_seconds.description: Page-visit triggers only: fire once the visitor has stayed this many seconds on a matching page.

source.description: Trigger source. page_visit pairs with event_name "$pageview" for URL or dwell triggers.

sampling_percent.description: Percent of matching users to invite (default 100).

cooldown_days.description: Days before the same user can be invited again (default 30).

max_invites_per_day.description: Daily invitation cap for this trigger (default 100).

intercept_title.description: Small label above the prompt, e.g. "AI-guided · 2-3 minutes".

intercept_body.description: Prompt text shown to the user.

delivery_method.description: intercept (default): in-app voice/text widget via the Usercall SDK. webhook: POST each matched user to webhook_url.

webhook_url.description: Public https endpoint for delivery_method webhook. Receives user ID, email, traits, event properties and a personal interview link. To remove a webhook, set delivery_method "intercept" (clears webhook_url and webhook_secret).

webhook_secret.description: Optional HMAC secret. Requests carry x-usercall-signature. Write-only and omitted from responses.

invite_link_params.description: Query params copied onto interview links when the study has link context enabled.

tools.name: list_research_triggers
tools.title: List research triggers
tools.description: List research triggers with status and activation_url. activation_url is present while a trigger is paused and empty after a person activates it. Does not change a trigger and cannot activate one.

tools.name: get_research_trigger
tools.title: Get a research trigger
tools.description: Read one research trigger by trigger_id, including status, targeting, and activation_url. activation_url is present while the trigger is paused. Does not change the trigger, cannot activate it, and does not return interview findings.

tools.name: update_research_trigger
tools.title: Update a research trigger
tools.description: Edit a research trigger's targeting, sampling, cooldown, daily cap, intercept copy, or delivery. status paused pauses the trigger. status active is rejected with HTTP 409 and activation_url; a person opens that URL to activate. Editing an active trigger pauses it until a person approves it again. Does not activate a trigger.

event_name.description: Observed event name for this account.

anyOf.description: Page URL rule. Matches the page path, query or hash.

url.description: Page URL rule. Matches the page path, query or hash.

anyOf.description: Trigger source. page_visit pairs with event_name "$pageview" for URL or dwell triggers.

source.description: Trigger source. page_visit pairs with event_name "$pageview" for URL or dwell triggers.

sampling_percent.description: Percent of matching users to invite (default 100).

cooldown_days.description: Days before the same user can be invited again (default 30).

max_invites_per_day.description: Daily invitation cap for this trigger (default 100).

intercept_title.description: Small label above the prompt, e.g. "AI-guided · 2-3 minutes".

intercept_body.description: Prompt text shown to the user.

delivery_method.description: intercept (default): in-app voice/text widget via the Usercall SDK. webhook: POST each matched user to webhook_url.

webhook_url.description: Public https endpoint for delivery_method webhook. Receives user ID, email, traits, event properties and a personal interview link. To remove a webhook, set delivery_method "intercept" (clears webhook_url and webhook_secret).

webhook_secret.description: Optional HMAC secret. Requests carry x-usercall-signature. Write-only and omitted from responses. null removes it.

invite_link_params.description: Query params copied onto interview links when the study has link context enabled.

status.description: Trigger status. "paused" pauses the trigger. "active" is rejected with HTTP 409 and activation_url; a person opens that URL to activate.

tools.name: delete_research_trigger
tools.title: Delete a research trigger
tools.description: Permanently delete a research trigger. Interviews already completed are kept. Cannot be undone. Does not delete the study. Pausing a trigger stops new invites and keeps the trigger.
